sloka: श्रावयाम् आस तत्त्वज्ञः सर्व भूत भव अभवौ ।उत्थितौ तौ नर व्याघ्रौ प्रकाशेते यशस्विनौ ॥२-७७-२५॥
transliteration: śrāvayām āsa tattvajñaḥ sarva bhūta bhava abhavau ।utthitau tau nara vyāghrau prakāśete yaśasvinau ॥2-77-25॥

translations.english: Having risen from the earth both the illustrious tigers among men, Bharata and Satrughna looked faded and weather beaten like the banners of Indra that had faded under the Sun and rain.
